name: _healthPoints
label: Health
meaning: How much damage the structure can take before it is destroyed.

name: _hoursToDecay
label: Decay time
meaning: How long before an unmaintained structure decays. 672 means 28 days.

name: _hoursToDecayOutsideFlagArea
label: Decay time outside flag
meaning: The decay timer when the structure sits outside your flag area. -1 means never.

name: _destructionTime
label: Destruction time
meaning: How long it takes to destroy the structure.

name: _repairTime
label: Repair time
meaning: How long repairing the structure takes.

name: _explosionResistance
label: Explosion resistance
meaning: How well the structure resists explosions.

name: _experienceAwardForBuilding
label: XP for building
meaning: Experience given for building the structure.

name: _repairableParams.ExperienceAwardedPerHealthRepaired
label: XP per health repaired
meaning: Experience given for each point of health you repair.

name: _isClimbable
label: Climbable
meaning: Whether players can climb the structure.

name: _canBePainted
label: Can be painted
meaning: Whether the structure can be painted.

name: StaticMesh
label: Model
meaning: A link to the structure's model (art).

name: _canBePlacedWithoutFlag
label: Place without a flag
meaning: Whether it can be placed outside a flag area.

name: _canBePlacedInBuilding
label: Place inside a building
meaning: Whether it can be placed inside a building.

name: _canBePlacedInRestrictedArea
label: Place in a restricted area
meaning: Whether it can be placed in a restricted area.

name: _canBePlacedOnOtherBaseElements
label: Place on other elements
meaning: Whether it can sit on top of other base elements.

name: _canBeGroundedOnOtherElements
label: Rest on other elements
meaning: Whether it can rest on other elements.

name: _canEverBePlacedOnFoundation
label: Place on a foundation
meaning: Whether it can be placed on a foundation.

name: _checkOverlapsBelowOnUpgrade
label: Check overlaps when upgrading
meaning: Whether overlaps below are checked when it is upgraded.

name: _ignoreDisabledBaseBuildingFlag
label: Place when building is off
meaning: Whether it can still be placed when base building is switched off (engine).

name: _isBlockingItemPlacement
label: Blocks item placement
meaning: Whether it blocks items being placed nearby.

name: _supportsPatterns
label: Supports paint patterns
meaning: Whether it supports paint patterns.

name: _disableBeingDestroyedByOtherElement
label: Cannot be destroyed by other elements
meaning: Whether other elements cannot destroy it.

name: _shouldDestroyElementWhenMovedOutOfFlag
label: Destroyed when moved out of flag
meaning: Whether it is destroyed when taken out of the flag area.

name: _shouldDestroyAssociatedItemWhenMovedOutOfFlag
label: Destroy item when moved out of flag
meaning: Whether the matching item is destroyed when taken out of the flag area.

name: _isUsedForRespawn
label: Used for respawn
meaning: Whether it acts as a respawn point.

name: _replenishableResourceDescription.PeriodicReplenishment.MaxAmount
label: Reserve size
meaning: The most resource a refilling element (like the well) can hold.

name: _replenishableResourceDescription.PeriodicReplenishment.ReplenishAmount
label: Refill amount
meaning: How much is added each refill.

name: _replenishableResourceDescription.PeriodicReplenishment.ReplenishInterval
label: Refill interval
meaning: Seconds between refills.

name: _useSimpleCollisionForOverlaps
label: Simple collision for overlaps
meaning: Whether simple collision is used for overlap checks (engine).

name: _useBoxOverlapTypeWhitelist
label: Use overlap whitelist
meaning: Whether the overlap whitelist is used (engine).

name: _boxOverlapTypeWhitelist
label: Overlap whitelist
meaning: The overlap whitelist value (a bitmask; engine).

name: _repairableParams.MinSkillLevelRequired
label: Repair skill needed
meaning: The lowest skill level that can repair it (e.g. ESkillLevel::Medium).

name: _maxInstancesPerFlagArea
label: Max instances per flag area
meaning: How many of this element may exist in one flag area. Tested in game.
